text: dsh-open-with-vscode 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件，会话头部会出现一个 VS Code 按钮。点击后，客户端把当前会话的工作目录发给宿主路由，由宿主定位并启动 VS Code 打开该目录；按钮仅在会话有工作目录时显示，启动失败会显示提示。适合希望从 DSH 会话直接进入当前项目代码的用户。需要本机安装 VS Code。

dsh-open-with-vscode adds a VS Code button to the DSH session header. Clicking it sends the current workspace directory to the host, which launches VS Code. The button appears only when a session has a working directory. Requires VS Code installed locally.
想从当前 DSH 会话一键在 VS Code 打开项目目录
Open the current DSH session workspace in VS Code with one click.
Add a session header control that launches VS Code for the active workspace.
dsh-open-with-vscode 的功能「从会话打开工作区」：会话头部显示 VS Code 按钮；点击后将当前会话 cwd 发给宿主，并启动 VS Code 打开该目录。没有工作目录时不显示按钮。
dsh-open-with-vscode 的功能「定位并启动 VS Code」：宿主查找本机 Code.exe，再以当前工作区目录作为启动参数打开 VS Code；若找不到程序或启动失败，会返回错误供按钮显示提示。

dsh-open-with-vscode README · dsh-open-with-vscode：> 修复 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端「用 VS Code 打开」失效问题的插件：在会话头部「打开方式」**左侧**新增一个按钮，一键在 VS Code 中打开当前会话的工作区目录。

dsh-open-with-vscode README · 为什么需要它：DSH 桌面宿主以 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 启动（桌面壳以 Electron 的 Node 模式派生核心宿主）。内置 `open-in-app` 启动子进程时用 `{ ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...options.env }` 构造环境，而 `scrubbedParentEnv()` 只过滤 `/KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i` 与 `DSH_*` 前缀，**并不剔除 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`**：

- VS Code（同为 Electron）继承该变量后把自己当成 Node 解释器，把目录参数当成模块 `require`，随即以退出码 1 结束
- 路由返回 `HTTP 502 {"code":"launch-failed"}`，按钮毫无反应
- 该问题已在 deepseek-harness 讨论 [#8049](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8049) 反馈，V0.2.1-rc.3 仍复现
dsh-open-with-vscode README · 为什么需要它：本插件**不修改内置 open-in-app**，而是提供独立的路由与按钮，绕开该 BUG。

dsh-open-with-vscode README · 功能：- 在会话头部「打开方式」**左侧**新增 VS Code 图标按钮（`order: -20`，位于内置 `-10` 之前）
- 点击后在 VS Code 中打开**当前会话的工作区目录**，随会话切换自动跟随
- 启动环境按大小写不敏感剔除 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`（"先清继承、后合显式"，与社区修法一致）
- 不影响宿主自身环境：经 Windows Job runner 执行的命令（pwsh / grep 等）不受干扰

```yaml

    - id: open-in-vscode

dsh-open-with-vscode README · 使用：1. 打开任意会话（其工作目录即为目标目录）
2. 点击会话头部右上角、位于「打开方式」左侧的 VS Code 图标按钮
3. VS Code 随即打开该工作区目录

按钮仅在会话存在工作目录时显示；启动失败会在按钮下方给出错误提示。

dsh-open-with-vscode README · 工作原理：- **Host 端**：提供独立的 `POST /open-in-vscode` 路由（带与内置一致的认证围栏与请求校验），定位 `Code.exe`（LOCALAPPDATA / Program Files / App Paths 注册表 / PATH 兜底），用清洗过、剔除 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 的环境 `detached` 启动
- **Client 端**：注册 `conversation.session.header.utilities` 槽位（`order: -20`），读取会话 `cwd`，点击后请求上述路由

dsh-open-with-vscode README · 与内置「打开方式」对比：| | 内置 open-in-app | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| VS Code 能否打开 | ❌ 502（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 泄漏） | ✅ 正常打开 |
| 按钮位置 | 会话头部 | 「打开方式」左侧 |
| 目标 | 需手动选择应用 | 固定 VS Code + 当前工作区 |
| 是否修改内置实现 | — | 否，独立路由 |

dsh-open-with-vscode README · 兼容性：- Windows（VS Code 桌面版 `Code.exe`）
- DSH 桌面端 V0.2.1-rc.3（及携带 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 泄漏的版本）
- macOS / Linux 暂未适配（可执行文件定位仅实现 Windows 路径）

dsh-open-with-vscode README · dsh-open-with-vscode：> A DeepSeek Harness plugin that fixes the broken "Open in VS Code" flow: adds a button **left of** the built-in "Open In..." control in the session header, opening the current session's workspace directory in VS Code with one click.

dsh-open-with-vscode README · Why this plugin：The DSH desktop host starts with `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` (the desktop shell spawns the core host in Electron's Node mode). The built-in `open-in-app` builds child environments with `{ ...scrubbedParentEnv(), ...options.env }`, but `scrubbedParentEnv()` only filters `/KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i` and the `DSH_*` prefix — it does **not** remove `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`:

dsh-open-with-vscode README · Why this plugin：- VS Code (also an Electron app) inherits that variable, treats itself as a Node interpreter, tries to `require` the directory argument as a module, and exits with code 1 almost immediately
- The route answers `HTTP 502 {"code":"launch-failed"}` — the button does nothing
- Reported in deepseek-harness discussion [#8049](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/8049); still reproducible on V0.2.1-rc.3
dsh-open-with-vscode README · Why this plugin：This plugin does **not** modify the built-in `open-in-app`. It provides its own route and button that sidestep the bug.

dsh-open-with-vscode README · Features：- Adds a VS Code icon button **left of** the built-in "Open In..." in the session header (`order: -20`, before the built-in `-10`)
- Opens the **current session's workspace directory** in VS Code; follows session switches automatically
- Launch environment scrubs `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` case-insensitively ("clear the inherited first, then merge explicit", matching the community fix)
- Never touches the host's own environment: commands executed through the Windows Job runner (pwsh / grep, etc.) are unaffected

dsh-open-with-vscode README · or：pnpm add dsh-open-with-vscode
```

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: open-in-vscode
      name: dsh-open-with-vscode
      config: {}

dsh-open-with-vscode README · Usage：1. Open any session (its working directory becomes the target)
2. Click the VS Code icon button at the top-right of the session header, left of "Open In..."
3. VS Code opens that workspace directory

The button only appears when the session has a working directory; on launch failure an error notice is shown under the button.

The tooltip follows the DSH language automatically — in an English UI it reads "Open in VS Code".

dsh-open-with-vscode README · How it works：- **Host side**: provides an independent `POST /open-in-vscode` route (same auth fence and request validation as the built-in), locates `Code.exe` (LOCALAPPDATA / Program Files / App Paths registry / PATH fallback), and launches it `detached` with a scrubbed environment that excludes `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`
- **Client side**: registers the `conversation.session.header.utilities` slot (`order: -20`), reads the session `cwd`, and calls that route on click

dsh-open-with-vscode README · Built-in "Open In..." comparison：| | Built-in open-in-app | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Opens VS Code | ❌ 502 (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` leak) | ✅ works |
| Button position | session header | left of "Open In..." |
| Target | pick an app manually | fixed VS Code + current workspace |
| Modifies built-in? | — | no, independent route |

dsh-open-with-vscode README · Compatibility：- Windows (VS Code desktop `Code.exe`)
- DSH desktop V0.2.1-rc.3 (and versions carrying the `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` leak)
- macOS / Linux not yet adapted (executable discovery is Windows-only)
